name: Beam Cloud On-demand - L40S PCIe
price_basis: per L40S PCIe machine-hour, on-demand, including 12 vCPU + 96 GB RAM + 1 TB NVMe. Fetched 2026-10-04. This is a per-machine rate for a single-GPU machine, so it is also the per-GPU rate.
notes: Beam on-demand L40S at $0.76/hr is the cheapest published L40S rate from any managed provider. It is 66% below CoreWeave on-demand L40S ($2.25), 79% below Replicate ($3.51), and 58% below Paperspace (if Paperspace L40S were listed). The rate includes the full machine (12 vCPU, 96GB RAM, 1TB NVMe). Beam charges no egress fees. The L40S is a inference-optimized GPU with 48GB GDDR6 memory, well-suited for medium-size model inference.
